model_classification.method: Model block: successful or failed results whose answer was not settled by the literal absence rule (those have a model attempt with execution mode 'rules').
notes: 12 of 39 model calls failed (11 were rejected because the quoted text did not match the answer exactly). A failed call is not brand absence.

Only 1 of 27 successful model results recommended Kasparro. This may mean the model under-detects recommendations; on the 8-case held-out check only 5 of 8 cases gave a valid answer, and the model found 0 recommendations among them.

diagnostics.title: Gemini is furthest from the branded-prompt average

diagnostics.title: What the classifier found in the answers it read (execution mode: rules+hosted_groq)
diagnostics.observed_pattern: Of 27 successful model results, 26 mention Kasparro without recommending it and 1 recommend it. 11 describe it negatively (this overlaps the others). Coverage: 27 successful; 12 of 39 model calls failed; 33 answers were not sent.
diagnostics.possible_explanation: Hypothesis, not verified: Only 1 of 27 successful model results recommended Kasparro. This may mean the model under-detects recommendations; on the 8-case held-out check only 5 of 8 cases gave a valid answer, and the model found 0 recommendations among them.
diagnostics.evidence_needed: A reviewer reads the linked answers and marks mention, recommendation and negative wording without seeing the model label. Compare with the model's counts.

remedies.title: Fix the model quote-failure path
remedies.problem: 12 of 39 model calls failed, and 11 of those failed because the quoted text did not match the archived answer exactly. Each failed answer is missing from the model results. A failure is not brand absence.
remedies.action: Change the model reply so it returns sentence numbers instead of quoted text. The code then copies the exact sentence from the archived answer. Develop and test this only on the labelled development cases.
remedies.expected_benefit: More named answers get a valid classification. It does not change what the model decides, and it makes no promise about ranking or visibility.
remedies.validation_step: With the owner's approval, re-run the 12 failed answers. Success is the number that now validate out of 12, and every excerpt is still found word for word in its answer.

remedies.title: Study the prompts where Kasparro is not named
remedies.problem: Kasparro is named in 0 of 60 answers to unbranded prompts. It is never named there, so the linked answers show what the engines say instead, but the archive does not show why, or which brands the engines name across all answers.
remedies.action: An analyst reads the linked answers and lists which brands they name instead. Then a larger, reviewed set of unbranded prompts is archived with the same engines.
remedies.expected_benefit: Shows whether the gap comes from prompt wording or from the engines. It makes no promise that any change will improve ranking.
remedies.validation_step: On a new archived sample, report how many answers to unbranded prompts name Kasparro, out of how many, and compare with 0 of 60 today.

remedies.title: Check recommendation counts by hand
remedies.problem: Only 1 of 27 successful model results recommended Kasparro. The model may be missing recommendations, so this count should not be trusted yet.
remedies.action: A reviewer reads all 27 successful model-classified answers and marks which ones recommend Kasparro, without seeing the model label first.
remedies.expected_benefit: Shows whether the recommendation count is too low before anyone relies on it.
remedies.validation_step: Count the answers the reviewer marks as recommendations and compare with the model's 1. Report the disagreements out of 27.
